name: ainecto
description: Shared project memory for people and AI agents: workspaces, documents, ERD, diagrams and boards.
longDescription: AiNecto is shared project memory for people and AI agents. Your agent can see what is waiting for you (notifications, to-dos and assigned kanban cards), find and review documents with comments, run kanban cards through their workflow, set up workspaces and projects, and write status reports — all against the same workspaces, documents, ERDs, diagrams and boards your team uses on ainecto.com. Sign in once with your AiNecto account; what the agent may change is decided by your AiNecto permissions.
defaultPrompts: What is waiting for me in AiNecto?
Review the latest version of our design document and leave comments
Write a status report for this week's kanban board

panel.name: ainecto-panel
panel.description: A Claude Code pane for AiNecto: your notifications, comments you can reply to, and your kanban work, beside the conversation. Uses your existing AiNecto connection.
